_readme: FIAT, THE COUNTY'S CREWS (26 Oct), step 3 of 3: the sixteen poses (each references its standing figure - run once the stands are on disk): 16 jobs.
Run: tools\art.bat county_gangs_poses (the dry run first, then it asks)

The County's crews: a face a zone (art/people/gang_<zone>.png) and two members' standing, firing and going-down figures (art/fight/gang_<zone>_<a|b>_<pose>.png). RunView draws them on a County run (run_view.gd county_gang), else the host site's crew.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_county_gangs_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

One person alone, full body head to feet, facing the viewer, centred, filling the frame top to bottom, plain dark neutral background.
